# Paul Irving & Rachel Lynde

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — fond of him despite him being a Yankee · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, taking note of her new students, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, an eccentric mother, Mrs. Donnell, visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is cheered by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) presenting her with flowers, and later discusses the day's events with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives home with the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose contrasting behaviors quickly manifest during dinner and bedtime. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates chaos throughout his first week, first by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church and later by tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen before attempting to pump water on her. After being sent to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also placed a toad in Marilla's bed, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frantically removes.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a peaceful walk home along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and chats with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted for his trickery and lying, eventually breaking down in remorse and promising to reform before being sent to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her amusing experiences as a teacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny anecdotes about her students' responses in class and transcribes several composition letters written by her pupils, including an overly dramatic one from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied from old love letters and an imaginative letter from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) describing his fictional rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> In an irritable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing fireworks to explode in the classroom and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Returning home in despair, she confesses to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who comforts her and reassures her that everyone makes mistakes. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is amazed to find that whipping Anthony actually won his respect, a fact later confirmed by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), her past relationship with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the health of [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) while managing Davy's poor table manners. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dyed feathers for an Indian headdress to keep him happy. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), which ensures they can stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passes away, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Upon learning of Anne's resignation from teaching, her pupils react with distress, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a quiet conversation discussing the upcoming changes and their enduring friendship.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before heading to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to help Miss Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for the wedding. The wedding ceremony takes place in the garden, attended by guests including Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) return to lock up the house and share a quiet, romantic moment together.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
